environment.browser: Headless Chromium; visible foreground page; software GPU. Frozen source served by a local HTTP server, with no Playwright request interception. Image/media/fonts unavailable in the sparse checkout and blocked by CSP; this measures JS/layout, not complete device rendering or battery life.
environment.foreground: Native tick, settleDeadMobs and flushTickRender at 100ms scheduling, state.ff=false. Only automatic game/save timers are stopped to prevent a second combat clock; native sprite, VFX, UI intervals and rAF remain enabled.
environment.audit: Synchronous native ticks, state.ff=true. Same seeded combat RNG, ordered relic callback and damage/heal event digests, per-tick outcome digest and final combat state. Measurement-only wrappers preserve arguments, return values and execution order.

semanticAudit.method: Every module callback counted and ordered rolling digest recorded; all observed native damage/healing event rows compared byte for byte; per-tick HP/MP/outcomes/RNG and complete final combat state identical.

limitations: Foreground VFX and combat share Math.random; visual scheduling consumes a different number of random draws. Foreground timing pairs use the same seed and 480 ticks but are not asserted to have byte-identical battle traces; exact equivalence is established in the separate synchronous native audit.
One fresh document per case/rate, one recorded foreground trial per condition. Empirical tick quantiles, not multi-device confidence intervals.
Sparse checkout lacks graphics/audio/fonts; CSP blocks those resources. Real-device GPU, decoding, audio and battery behavior are not measured.
Only combat/save clocks replaced by a fixed 100ms measurement scheduler. Native sprite/VFX/UI timers remain live; automatic catch-up is not used in this fixed-workload stress test.
480 ticks are 48 simulated seconds and do not measure full four-dragon completion. Balance results require the separate current-version matrix.
The frozen measured delta isolates only cache/dispatch work. Later card, text, display and save-lifecycle changes are outside this timing pair and are covered by separate integration checks.

preliminaryAnomaly.description: One provisional reload/interception run had unequal intermediate rolling digests while callback/event counts, per-tick outcomes, final state and RNG were identical. No cause was established; the record is retained and excluded from formal performance/equivalence results.
